jobs.title: City cleanup
jobs.prompt: Faithful production-background edit of the supplied pixel-art cyberpunk city. Return ONE clean 16:9 city image, same exact fixed camera and framing. Remove ALL game interface overlays: the NEON PIXEL / RIOT PROTOCOL / RETRO REBEL logo, every floating accent dot and divider belonging to the logo, all five center buttons including their frames and text, all bottom keyboard hints, and the DEVELOPMENT corner link. Also remove the cyan-windowed metro vehicle sitting on the elevated railway at right. Reconstruct the missing city, distant buildings, bridge and lower street coherently behind these removed objects. The elevated railway must continue empty and level across the image at its present height; preserve its railings, support pillars and deep-blue concrete face so a separate sprite vehicle can later pass across. Preserve the existing detailed pixel-cluster art, crisp stair-step silhouettes, dark navy architecture, cyan and magenta neon, amber storefronts, individual roof shapes, near-side framing pipes and foreground ledge, wet reflective lower street, distant towers and textured night sky. Keep the current signage including pictograms and short invented shop words intact; these physical shop signs are NOT the interface and should remain visible. Preserve NYVO, VEKZA, NEXO, KORU, PIXL and the bowl, ring and geometric signs in their original positions. Do not move existing buildings or introduce a large focal tower in the cleared center. Reconstructed upper-center buildings should be darker and lower-contrast, with restrained sparse windows, leaving readable negative space for a future separate logo. Reconstruct the lower street through the cleared menu area, without people or cars. Keep exactly this rich city and asymmetrical depth; no redesign, no empty black rectangle, no substituted blank gradient, no blur, no smooth photorealistic painting, no new text overlays, no logo, no UI, no vehicle, no rain streaks. Output only the clean finished city plate.

jobs.title: Three-car metro reconstruction
jobs.prompt: Prepare ONE production prop asset for the same pixel-art city in the reference. Extract the DESIGN of the small dark-blue metro vehicle on the elevated railway at the right, and draw its COMPLETE unobscured vehicle as a standalone HORIZONTAL SIDE-VIEW sprite. Show a short three-car metro consist with a slanted right-facing cab at the right end, deep navy steel body, thin dark outlines, a low roof, cyan luminous rectangular windows, small violet-magenta vertical door lights, dark undercarriage and tiny mostly recessed wheels. Preserve the reference's angular blocky pixel-art style and modest industrial design. The entire vehicle is exactly level with the image horizontal axis; no three-quarter angle, no perspective taper, no tilt, no track or platform. Keep its silhouette long and low, total length about seven times its body height. Place the entire vehicle near the center of a flat uniform light gray background with empty margin on all four sides. Hard clean pixel-stepped silhouette; cyan light contained inside windows; no glow halo, no smoke or particles, no cast shadow on the background. This will be cut out as an RGBA game sprite, so no building, no bridge, no scenic background, no logo or game UI, no labels, no text. Fill about 90 percent of the canvas width with the vehicle and leave enough top/bottom margin. Output only this one complete side-profile metro sprite on the plain light gray background.

jobs.title: Transparent metro
jobs.prompt: Only the complete connected blue metro vehicle, including all three cars, couplings, dark outlines, undercarriage and wheels. Remove the light gray background.

jobs.title: Left sign revision
jobs.prompt: Make exactly one localized signage change to the supplied finished pixel-art cyberpunk city. At FAR LEFT, the large tall magenta rectangular neon sign currently contains a bowl/cup with three rising steam strokes. Replace only that bowl/cup-and-steam pictogram with a classic neon gentlemen's-club / strip-club pictogram: a recognizable stylized ADULT woman pole dancer shown as a simple tasteful hot-pink neon outline, wearing a leotard and high heels, one raised arm holding a straight vertical pole and one elegantly bent knee. Iconic side silhouette like a vintage nightlife neon sign, no explicit anatomy, no nudity. Fit the complete pictogram comfortably INSIDE the exact existing tall rectangular neon frame, leaving clear margins. Use the same magenta, pink-white neon tubes, dark red inset and restrained glow as the original coffee sign. Keep the sign's outline, mounting, size, location and rectangular perspective unchanged. No words need to be added. Preserve EVERY other part of this image exactly: all buildings and their silhouettes, far city, sky, left VEKZA sign, all other sign colors and wording, empty level railway with its fine posts and lights, wet street, pipes and foreground platform. Keep the original crisp chunky pixel-cluster texture and fixed camera. Do not reinterpret, redesign, crop, reframe, sharpen or blur the city. No train, people standing in the city, logo or game UI. Output the same full city plate with only the far-left sign's central icon changed.
